command: GOMAXPROCS=8 go test ./internal/engine -run ^TestTTS -bench ^BenchmarkTTSPointwiseDirect$ -benchtime=9x -count=1 -benchmem (once each with CGO_ENABLED=0 and 1)
method: Nine alternating old/current pairs, each time sample averaging sixteen calls. Output and workspace are warmed/reused. Both paths retain identical parameter/overlap validation; the reference reconstructs the previous packing algorithm. Custom medians are per call; standard Go ns/op covers a 32-call pair and timing overhead.
limits: Host was not isolated. Wide controls use the packed path and showed timing differences under background load; these data do not isolate their cause. These are convolution operator measurements, not whole-utterance throughput or model RSS. No official MMS checkpoint run was made.
dispatch: Direct CHW GEMM only for unpadded kernel=1, at most four output rows per group and at most 128 frames. Wider, depthwise and long convolutions keep the existing packed/depthwise paths and cancellation boundaries.
validation: Bitwise packed/direct outputs across 1,31,127,128,129,257 frames, groups 1/2, 2/4/12 output channels, optional bias and dilation 3, in both CGO modes.
Input remains unchanged; direct cases allocate no patch/projected buffers.

All TestTTS tests including scalar convolutions, validation/cancellation, partial aliases, buffer reuse and synthetic Torch vocoder reference pass with CGO_ENABLED=0 and 1. Official MMS parity skipped because no checkpoint was configured.
